AccountCount.title: AccountCount
AccountCount.description: Number of Account records returned. Zero if no accounts matched the search criteria.

ResultsSummary.title: ResultsSummary
ResultsSummary.description: Formatted summary of matching Account records, one per line. Empty string if AccountCount is zero.

ErrorMessage.title: ErrorMessage
ErrorMessage.description: Error message if the search could not be executed. Empty string if no error occurred.
